name: neon alley
description: narrow rain-slicked urban alley, towering neon signs in red and blue reflecting off wet cobblestones, steam rising from grates, laundry lines overhead

name: server room
description: vast underground server room, rows of towering black server racks with blinking blue LEDs, cold white overhead lighting, cables bundled along ceiling

name: rooftop garden
description: elevated rooftop garden above the city, planter boxes full of wildflowers and herbs, rusted fire escapes visible, skyline glittering in the distance

name: abandoned warehouse
description: derelict industrial warehouse, broken skylights letting shafts of dust-filled light pierce the darkness, rusted machinery, graffiti on crumbling brick walls
